sloka: ते मया सम्क्रमा भग्नाः परिखाः च अवपूरिताः ।दग्धा च नगरी लंका प्राकाराः च अवसादिताः ॥६-३-२९॥।।
transliteration: te mayā samkramā bhagnāḥ parikhāḥ ca avapūritāḥ ।dagdhā ca nagarī laṁkā prākārāḥ ca avasāditāḥ ॥6-3-29॥।।

translations.english: "I have destroyed some of those roadways, even filled up the moats, burnt parts of the city of Lanka, smashed the boundary walls and killed part of the powerful army."
